card.law_is_about: Modernising workplace biological-agent protections, including digital instruction and external exposure records.
card.they_want: Retain practical instruction and exercises when digital instruction is used.
card.they_claim: A Sinclair2013 safety-training study is identified as Journal of Safety Research46:145–150.
card.the_problem: Pages145–155 of that volume belong to a Boelhouwer et al. hazard-pictogram paper; the printed author/title and page coordinates do not identify the same article.

correction: In Journal of Safety Research volume46, pages145–155 identify Boelhouwer, Davis, Franco-Watkins, Dorris and Lungu’s2013 paper on hazard pictograms, DOI10.1016/j.jsr.2013.06.001. Elsevier-deposited metadata and the coauthor’s university record agree. The author’s stated145–150 interval lies within that different paper, and the printed Sinclair author/title combination is bibliographically inconsistent. The intended Sinclair reference has not been established.
effect: The printed locator does not identify the safety-training study invoked. Correcting it would allow the evidence behind the practical-instruction argument to be checked. No clinical or pedagogical conclusion about whether exercises are necessary is drawn from this citation error.
limits: No claim that no Sinclair training research exists or that the recommendation for practical instruction is wrong. A copied, blended or partly mistyped citation is plausible. Original article metadata and university-hosted abstract were read; the complete11-page Boelhouwer paper was not obtained or clinically reappraised. Preliminary secondary catalogue inference that these pages were a railway paper was rejected when primary metadata showed otherwise; it is not used as evidence.
materiality_explanation: Minor source-location error affecting verification of a supporting reference. It does not demonstrate that the practical-training request changes or that claimed learning effects are false.
context_and_alternatives: Full two-page DGAUM response read and original physical2 visually checked. The heading expressly presents occupational-medical evidence on digital instruction. Its paragraph supports useful theoretical digital learning while requiring practice for physical skills. There is no DOI in the printed reference. A genuine differently located Sinclair study could support the request; that does not make the printed source identity accurate.
